texts.hero_lead: Original concerts, showcases, and festivals across the Philippines and Australia — cast, directed, and produced in-house by Zentra One Entertainment.
texts.about_head_1: Talent deserves more than a booking.
texts.about_head_2: It deserves a show built around it.
texts.about_p1: That belief is the whole company. Zentra One Entertainment (ZOE) doesn't wait for stages to call — we build the stage, write the show, and put our talents at the center of it.
texts.about_p2: Operating across two markets, we bring Filipino artistry to Australian audiences and world-class production standards to Philippine stages.
texts.footer_blurb: A production company creating original shows and producing talents across the Philippines and Australia.
texts.footer_company: Part of Zentra One Pty Ltd · ABN 94 698 855 784 · Gloucester, NSW
